name: application-api-key-manager
title: API Key Manager
description: Table of API keys with masked values, reveal/copy actions, scope badges, last-used timestamps, and revoke, driven by a typed keys prop contract.
useWhen: A developer settings or integrations page needs to list, create, and revoke API credentials.
Each key has metadata (scopes, last-used) that should be scannable alongside the masked value.
Users need a quick reveal-or-copy action without navigating to a separate detail page.
avoidWhen: You only need to display a single read-only value with a copy action — use the Copy-to-Clipboard Field instead.
Keys are shown once at creation and never listed again — a one-time reveal dialog is safer than a persistent table.
Fine-grained per-scope editing is required — pair this table with a dedicated scope-editing form instead of inline badges.
responsiveBehavior: The table scrolls horizontally on narrow viewports via its wrapping overflow-x-auto container; the header bar and Create key action remain fixed above it.
accessibility: Reveal and copy icon buttons carry a dynamic aria-label naming the specific key they act on.
The masked key value uses a monospace <code> element so character grouping (bullets vs. visible suffix) stays legible.
The Revoke action is a plain text button labelled with the verb itself, not just an icon, to avoid destructive-action ambiguity.

variants.title: API Key Manager
variants.description: Key table with a masked value plus reveal/copy icon buttons, scope badges, last-used column, and a per-row revoke action.
accessibility: A key that has never been used shows 'Never' in a visually distinct but still text-based way, not an empty cell.

variants.title: API Key Manager (Dark)
variants.description: API key table adapted for dark surfaces with the same masked-value, scope-badge, and revoke-action structure.
accessibility: Masked-key monospace text, scope badges, and the destructive Revoke label must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
